title: Probability of flipping a sign
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $p=(1+\rho)/2$. For any sign $b\in\{−1,1\}$, the coordinate noise distribution with parameter $\rho$, started at $b$, assigns probability $1-p$ to $-b$.
